summary: Xiao-I Corp filed a Form 6-K disclosing entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement and closing of a $3.25 million convertible note issuance with an institutional investor (Streeterville Capital, LLC). The note carries a 6% interest rate, 12-month maturity, original issue discount of $240k, and transaction expenses resulting in $3.0M net proceeds. The deal includes 8,503,369 pre-delivery shares and potential additional notes. This is a routine financing arrangement, not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, or regulatory issues noted. What to watch: dilution from conversion and ability to repay.
